# Ten Independent Canva-Ready Scientific Visual Roles — V1

**Variant:** TEN_SLIDE_MSE_TRAINING; illustrative PNG/SVG **inserts**, not complete slide screenshots; not the canonical 8-slide Deck3, nor the working 13/14-slide chapter decks. Use exact slide message + **three approved actual bullets** per asset, source copy unchanged. These are art briefs, not claims of completion/verification.

| Slide | Main scientific visual | Real-world primary source use | Engineering/infographic grammar | Core prohibited inference |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 01 Title | restrained transformer–feeder–DC charger–EV unified scene | actual photos/independent source-grounded art | AC/DC pathway; small H(t) annotation only | PV, solar canopy, fake site and V2G |
| 02 Outline | research foundation → physics/methods → resilience/sustainability roadmap | **NO_PHOTO_JUSTIFIED** | three white-region typographic sections, meaningful arrows | repeat full equipment photo |
| 03 Background | Power and T_e exposed separately to common extreme heat | realistic transformer/EVSE reference | two system boundaries, ambient H(t), electrical supply, service requirement icons | ambient equals interdependency |
| 04 Problem and objectives | separate proposed I3 P→T_e and I2 T_e→P pathways | small bounded equipment crops when rights permit | dashed hypotheses + OPEN state-time question + frozen SO1/SO2/SO3 | guessed thermal/AC causal data and validation |
| 05 Physical architecture | eight selected components: P1/P2/P3/P4 and T1/T2/T3/T4 | transformer, feeder, control relay, cooling, DC charger, battery, HVAC real examples | actual AC/DC ports, system boundaries, containment and control signals | ONAN fan, P3 series, T3 separate charger, direct P2→T4 |
| 06 Methodology | evidence → B0/B1 electrical cases → thermal dynamics → directional tests → resilience and sustainability assessment | optional authentic equipment image, mostly native diagram | 5-stage workflow, qualified `dX/dt`, research arrows | simulations passed without running |
| 07 Progress | established scope / assessed evidence / open validation | **NO_PHOTO_JUSTIFIED** | maturity/evidence matrix, original document icons | invented completion percentages, extra PV/stationary storage |
| 08 Resilience and sustainability | Q_P(t),Q_T(t) vs required service + two sustainability pathways | **NO_PHOTO_JUSTIFIED** unless small independently permitted context asset useful | service requirement and maintain/recover; two matched comparisons; three separate dimensions env/econ/soc | made-up service trajectories, direct SDG-impact claim, effective=sustainable |
| 09 Remaining work | Oct 2026–Apr 2027 research milestone timeline | **NO_PHOTO_JUSTIFIED** | calendar axis, separate milestones and dependencies, PROPOSED | completed future outcomes |
| 10 Closing | minimal original/reused approved infrastructure motif + three takeaway icons | reuse approved Slide 01 real photo art **only if cleared** | physical understanding, resilience, sustainability | new findings or claimed validation |

**Slide 08 scientific priority:** Required electricity and mobility service through physical state–time changes is *resilience*; environmental, economic, social consequences are *sustainability*. Direct pathway: thermal interdependency → service consequence → dimensions; intervention pathway: Improve/Adapt/Restore → changed service → dimensions. `ΔS_H=S_H−S_0` and `ΔS_A=S_A−S_H` require matching boundaries/units/time. No fourth SO. SDG target mapping begins at **measured, qualified** indicators only.

**10 image rule:** `slide01.png ... slide10.png` and corresponding available `.svg` each are independent and correctly registered. Do not generate 10 panels in one image. Titles, speaker notes, citations, main 3 bullets and long equations stay as editable slide objects.

**Visual style:** white canvas and panel interiors, Times New Roman authored labels, all authored marks in governed palette. The user's preferred approved composition style is hybrid real-world apparatus + precisely drawn source-qualified arrows/boundaries, but *not the same design repeated ten times*.
